title: Greek Feta Pie
description: A delicious and savory pie filled with crumbled feta cheese, perfect as a side dish or light lunch.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together the crumbled feta cheese, whisked egg, and Greek yogurt.
Pour the mixture into a pie dish and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the filling is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
